skills.name: bikeshed-feedback
skills.description: Use when reading review comments on a Bikeshed document and revising it — each comment arrives with the exact passage it is anchored to, so you can rewrite that passage and reply in the thread without fetching and diffing the whole document.

skills.name: bikeshed-folders
skills.description: Use when organising a Bikeshed workspace — listing the folder tree, creating folders, and filing documents into them. Read this before moving a document, because a folder decides who can read what is inside it.

skills.name: bikeshed-publishing
skills.description: Use when a finished write-up is meant for other people — a report for a team, a plan, a proposal, the case for a decision, an analysis a reviewer will act on, anything to be posted or presented — rather than a built-in artifact tool or a file left on disk; and when publishing or revising a document on a Bikeshed deployment.
